s1.description: Opening: retrieval warm-up, outcomes and the 3-hour plan

s2.description: Block 1: strain and stress recovery at a point from the nodal displacements, principal and von Mises stresses

s3.description: Block 2: accuracy of recovered stresses, centroid versus point values, mesh convergence of stresses, and the singularity at the fixed corner

s4.description: Block 3: the eight-node serendipity element, its load distribution and its accuracy compared with the four-node element

s5.description: Block 4: the standard for reporting finite element results — idealisation, convergence table, independent check, quantified conclusion

s6.description: Block 5: the hybrid group project: brief, stage gates, candidate structures, rubric, workflow and the Gate 0 plan drafted in class

s7.description: Block 6: summary of the plane-stress sessions, exit ticket and preparation for the ANSYS demonstration
